items.title: 3 US Stocks Riding The AI Data Center Power And Cooling Buildout
items.summary: AI is burning through compute and power, and the Anthropic IPO, Nvidia leadership questions, and fresh regulatory scrutiny have pushed that reality into sharp focus for investors. Money chasing AI is not just flowing into model developers; it is pulling attention toward the digital plumbing behind them. This article explains how three US stocks exposed to that story could either benefit from, or be hurt by, this surge in demand. The stocks covered below are just a sample, and the full screen...

items.title: Samsung Wants to Buy an American AI Data Center Cooling Company
items.summary: Modine's shares jumped after hours on a report of Samsung interest, yet the stock still sits far below its peak. Behind the rally lie missed earnings, negative cash flow, and a regulatory hurdle that could decide whether any deal happens.

items.title: Bloom Energy Soars 13%, Vertiv Up 14% in a Week as Data-Center Fears Ease
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 13% in the past week, with Vertiv and Oracle, after CoreWeave and Constellation Energy raised their 2026 guidance. Bloom had no news of its own, and with its orders and rising estimates intact, the bounce looks like it has further to go.
